description: React component for a modal dialog to confirm license removal in Mattermost admin console, including UI elements, Redux state management, and event handling.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining properties for the ConfirmLicenseRemovalModal component.

methods.name: ConfirmLicenseRemovalModal
methods.description: React functional component rendering a modal for license removal confirmation, handling open/close state and user actions.

methods.name: handleOnClose
methods.description: Handles closing the modal, calls optional onExited callback, and dispatches closeModal action.

methods.name: handleRemoval
methods.description: Handles the removal confirmation, calls optional handleRemove callback, and closes the modal.
